description: Implementation of UberQuicStreamIdManager class managing stream IDs for QUIC protocol, including stream opening, closing, and flow control.

classes.name: UberQuicStreamIdManager
classes.description: Manages stream IDs for bidirectional and unidirectional streams in QUIC.

methods.name: MaybeAllowNewOutgoingBidirectionalStreams
methods.description: Checks if new outgoing bidirectional streams are allowed.

methods.name: MaybeAllowNewOutgoingUnidirectionalStreams
methods.description: Checks if new outgoing unidirectional streams are allowed.

methods.name: SetMaxOpenIncomingBidirectionalStreams
methods.description: Sets maximum allowed incoming bidirectional streams.

methods.name: SetMaxOpenIncomingUnidirectionalStreams
methods.description: Sets maximum allowed incoming unidirectional streams.

methods.name: CanOpenNextOutgoingBidirectionalStream
methods.description: Determines if next outgoing bidirectional stream can be opened.

methods.name: CanOpenNextOutgoingUnidirectionalStream
methods.description: Determines if next outgoing unidirectional stream can be opened.

methods.name: GetNextOutgoingBidirectionalStreamId
methods.description: Retrieves the next outgoing bidirectional stream ID.

methods.name: GetNextOutgoingUnidirectionalStreamId
methods.description: Retrieves the next outgoing unidirectional stream ID.

methods.name: MaybeIncreaseLargestPeerStreamId
methods.description: Attempts to increase the largest peer stream ID if valid.

methods.name: OnStreamClosed
methods.description: Handles stream closure event.

methods.name: OnStreamsBlockedFrame
methods.description: Handles a frame indicating streams are blocked.

methods.name: IsAvailableStream
methods.description: Checks if a stream ID is available.

methods.name: GetMaxAllowdIncomingBidirectionalStreams
methods.description: Returns maximum allowed incoming bidirectional streams.

methods.name: GetMaxAllowdIncomingUnidirectionalStreams
methods.description: Returns maximum allowed incoming unidirectional streams.

methods.name: GetLargestPeerCreatedStreamId
methods.description: Returns the largest stream ID created by the peer.

methods.name: next_outgoing_bidirectional_stream_id
methods.description: Returns the next outgoing bidirectional stream ID.

methods.name: next_outgoing_unidirectional_stream_id
methods.description: Returns the next outgoing unidirectional stream ID.

methods.name: max_outgoing_bidirectional_streams
methods.description: Returns maximum number of outgoing bidirectional streams.

methods.name: max_outgoing_unidirectional_streams
methods.description: Returns maximum number of outgoing unidirectional streams.

methods.name: max_incoming_bidirectional_streams
methods.description: Returns maximum number of incoming bidirectional streams.

methods.name: max_incoming_unidirectional_streams
methods.description: Returns maximum number of incoming unidirectional streams.

methods.name: advertised_max_incoming_bidirectional_streams
methods.description: Returns advertised maximum incoming bidirectional streams.

methods.name: advertised_max_incoming_unidirectional_streams
methods.description: Returns advertised maximum incoming unidirectional streams.

methods.name: outgoing_bidirectional_stream_count
methods.description: Returns count of outgoing bidirectional streams.

methods.name: outgoing_unidirectional_stream_count
methods.description: Returns count of outgoing unidirectional streams.
